'''Akatoa''' was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] near [[Tartaglia]]. It was known for its [[Wind turbine/Legends|wind turbine]]s, to which [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]] annually migrated.<ref name="Phrase">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>
